mapping.intent: Words gather under a crook drawn around the phrase; shepherd becomes the quiet anchor.
Surrounding words open away from nothing; the emptied aperture remains spacious.
Individual letters grow upright from their roots into a green-grass horizon.
A roof and doorway are built around dwell as the preceding line crosses its threshold.
The sentence is carried upward from a shallow bowl trajectory and settles as nourished expands.
Words roll across one receding wave; the final rest settles onto an almost level waterline.
Separated letters of restored and soul reunite; the sentence resolves from fractured to whole.
Each exact word follows a bent guide thread; the thread straightens toward the human connection.
A stair of tilted word planes straightens into an unbroken path beneath righteousness.
The phrase unfolds like a signature from its center; an authored line signs beneath name.
Words cross the rain line in consecutive grounded steps, becoming a shared readable sentence.
A long cast shadow separates from shadow and death while the exact words stay in the light.
No grows into a protective opening while fear moves back and the phrase becomes level.
With and me approach along two curving arms and stop within a shelter contour.
Rod and staff pivot from strong vertical supports into a two-line editorial statement.
The phrase lowers into a visible supporting curve, then opens its tracking into a relaxed hold.
The line clears a pair of shadow shutters; no evil occupies the opening they leave.
Words arrive at distinct places around one drawn table and gather into two generous rows.
Those who afflict arcs around an intact protected center before returning to the full sentence.
Oil-shaped vertical traces touch down over head as that word rises to meet them.
The words fill an implied cup from its base, crest and spill gently into their reading positions.
A shallow camera journey passes word planes at successive depths and lands with them in one plane.
Two architectural shadow planes slide apart around a stable, fully readable central line.
A binding line loosens around fear; the exact letters release into a broad and level no evil.
You and me traverse opposite arcs into a shared center, the other words holding the reading order.
Two vertical supports lift rod and staff into place; surrounding words bridge between them.
Each word has a different damping arc that progressively becomes still beside comforted.
After its full reading interval, the exact letters assemble into one continuous protective arch across the caregivers.
Mercy leads a slow travelling line; the remaining words follow its curved wake into exact order.
Days cross a segment of a great circular path; life becomes its stationary center of gravity.
A prominent canonical mercy shares its exact reading station with generated golden filaments, then hands off to the fully formed generated word after the sung reading interval.
The phrase is drawn across an unbroken horizon; the camera settles while the horizon continues beyond it.
A distant plane carrying fear approaches and becomes human-sized; no evil opens slowly beside it.
With me rises together inside two nested contours that gently converge without enclosing the people.
The Lord is my follows a returning path into shepherd, which unfolds from a deep diagonal plane.
The exact word nothing settles as a surrounding oval opens into an infinite-looking horizontal line.
House and Lord become two reading stations in a single doorway; the rest passes through then settles.
Long gently extends the space around itself while the full phrase remains intact above a growing horizon.
The final shepherd becomes a fixed anchor as a surrounding circle resolves into the final open threshold.

observed.note: Only effective dispatched implementations count. Bypassed old switch cases are excluded. Distinct code bodies can still look repetitive; independent encoded review must judge at least30 meaningful choreography groups with none used more than3times.

streams.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

evidence.note: Actual encoded OCR samples; external independent visual critic also needs dense motion sequences, opening, transitions and all scene families.

checks.measured: Video, project object and detector source compared before/after review

limitations: Measures near-static pixels at 480px width and -55dB tolerance; it does not establish meaningful choreography, semantic motion or artistic quality.
Camera movement, animated texture or noise can avoid freeze detection without providing useful word motion. Independent visual review remains necessary.
Absolute interval times assume this is the complete project video, not a section-only export.

choreography.note: Only effective dispatched implementations count. Bypassed old switch cases are excluded. Distinct code bodies can still look repetitive; independent encoded review must judge at least30 meaningful choreography groups with none used more than3times.

limitations: Strict audio failures remain failures; good PCM correlation, source estimates and OCR cannot approve unsupported lyric sync.
Family IDs and implementation mapping are structural, not proof of meaningful visual variety.
Temporal pixel activity can be satisfied by texture without meaningful choreography.
No claim of artistic acceptance until independent review of exact encoded output is recorded.
